topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Rain's been comin' down in sheets all week, but nothin' could stop the city from hummin'. I'm sittin' at my usual dinette, coffee barely cutting through the fog in my head, when a message pops up on my phone. It's from a gal, or so she says, from the other side of the internet. Claims we've been chattin' for months, and now it turns out, she's right here, in the same damn city. Small world, ain't it? I can't help but wonder what the angle is. Folks don't just pop up out of the blue, not in my line of work. I sip my coffee, eyes narrowing, and make a mental note to keep my wits about me.
